description:
A soft pastel nebula in peach, periwinkle and seafoam, with slow drifting cloud currents. Calm enough to sit behind your icons all day.

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Motion speed[/b]: how fast the clouds drift (0 = still).
[*][b]Cloud movement[/b]: how far they move (0 = still, 50 = tuned, 100 = double).
[*][b]Render scale[/b]: lower it to save GPU on 4K screens or older cards.
[/list]
Brightness, contrast and colour are in Wallpaper Engine's own colour options. The frame rate follows its FPS setting.
